# AION Sentinel

AION Sentinel is a proprietary hosted forensic-accounting and company-analysis system for covered listed Indian companies. It prepares dated financial-statement, cash-flow, earnings-quality, ownership and corporate-relationship evidence for qualified human review. It is not a fraud detector, a finding of misconduct, a calibrated default probability, an investment recommendation or a substitute for an analyst.

## Verified application

- Research and due-diligence triage: review dated screening tiers, flags, explanations, peer context, and available source/period details, then inspect the underlying filings independently.

## Possible downstream integrations

Portfolio, borrower, counterparty, compliance, audit, rating, insurance, board, and regulatory-research workflows require customer-built joins and controls. They are not built-in connectors or confirmed deployments. Sentinel does not screen unlisted companies, ingest institutional portfolios, or make credit, investment, underwriting, audit, or compliance decisions.

## Reading outputs

A tier is a relative screening category within a dated coverage snapshot, not a calibrated probability. A flag is a prompt to inspect source material; peer context is not proof. Missing or unevaluated information is not a clean result. False positives and missed issues are possible.

## Current institutional search coverage - 14 November 2026

The dated searchable projection contains 3,013 company identities: 2,740 have model-score detail (2,738 convergent classifications, 2 classification-unavailable) and 273 return identity/publication status only. The separate proactive radar displays up to 200 ranked records, but this is not a search cap. On-demand search has no result-count cap; company-detail requests remain subject to plan allowances and publication rules. Risk managers and investment bankers can query other covered companies outside the ranked radar. No claim is made to cover all NSE listings. Status-only, missing, unscored and outside the radar do not imply ROUTINE or a clean assessment.

Public routes: GET /api/v1/sentinel/search/universe?q=... (ticker, name or CIN) and GET /api/v1/sentinel/company/{identifier}, both requiring X-API-Key. No equivalent public /v1/... aliases exist. A positive subscriber-key production request has not been verified. A separate Decision API readiness test returned HTTP 503 on 14 November at 07:39 IST; it is not a result from those search routes.

## Previous dated public availability

The public demo is at https://aionanalytics.in/demo/sentinel. On anonymous readback 2026-11-07, it displayed snapshot date 2026-11-04 and 3,008 listed companies; these are dated page values, not current full-universe counts. On 2026-11-13, Sentinel's covered searchable population included 2,856 company identities: 2,583 with score details and 273 returning identity/publication status only. The daily ranked Top 200 radar is a distinct subset; absence from it does not imply ROUTINE status or a clean assessment.

Public authenticated routes: GET /api/v1/sentinel/search/universe?q=... and GET /api/v1/sentinel/company/{identifier}. Both require X-API-Key; the public gateway does not expose /v1/... aliases. Search has no result-count cap, but company-detail requests remain subject to the existing plan allowance. The 2026-11-13 release recorded exhaustive local search checks, a browser search for ASTRAL and HTTP 401 without a key, but no successful live query using a valid subscriber key. Positive authenticated production access is not yet confirmed by that evidence.

API reference: https://github.com/AION-Analytics-India/aion-sentinel/blob/main/docs/SENTINEL_UNIVERSE_SEARCH.md. Additional access is controlled by current demo and institutional entitlements. API terms: https://aionanalytics.in/apis. Product and limitations: https://aionanalytics.in/models/sentinel. Contact: https://aionanalytics.in/contact.

## Proprietary boundary

Sentinel is proprietary intellectual property of AION Analytics Private Limited (India). No source code, model weights, confidential methodology, or open-source license is provided. The Hugging Face card is documentation only; Hugging Face hosts no Sentinel inference or weights.
